mapper.select: SELECT BUSICD AS busiCd, DATE_FORMAT(`DATE`, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS date, COMMENT AS comment, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %T' ) AS createDt FROM UI_HOLIDAY WHERE DATE_FORMAT(DATE,'%Y') = #{year} AND BUSICD = #{busiCd} ORDER BY `DATE`
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM UI_HOLIDAY WHERE DATE_FORMAT(DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d') AND BUSICD = #{busiCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_HOLIDAY(`DATE`, BUSICD, COMMENT, CREATE_DT) VALUES (#{date}, #{busiCd}, #{comment}, NOW() )
